cases.question: How does GenAI Template read a reproducible source snapshot when the working tree has local edits?
required_facts: The local reader resolves a Git ref to an immutable commit.
It reads tracked blobs from the Git object database without checking out or modifying the repository.

cases.question: How does GenAI Template preserve provenance when splitting documents from the flat portfolio corpus?
required_facts: The Markdown documents sit beside an authoritative manifest.json that maps each document to its provenance.
Manifest metadata is added to the documents before splitting so it reaches every chunk.
